title: Nothing Here Is Ever Lost
summary: Oisin newly arrived in the otherworld. Niamh shows him a place with no seasons and no graves, and he cannot stop counting. The seed of the homesickness that eventually takes him back.

scenes.visual: Wide shot. The princess stands small in a green valley of silver waterfalls and still pools, arm half-raised to the land around her. Static camera, low horizon.

dialogue.line: This is the valley I promised you. No one grows old here. No one is buried here.

scenes.visual: Three-quarter shot from the waist up, reverse angle. The warrior turning slowly, listening, the bright valley behind him. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I can hear water, and birds, and nothing else. Where is the sound of people working?

scenes.visual: Medium shot from the waist up. The princess turned three-quarters, pools and green mountainside behind her. She speaks gently. Static camera.

dialogue.line: There is no work that must be done. Nothing here is ever finished, because nothing here is ever lost.

scenes.visual: Medium shot over the shoulder, from the side. The warrior looking away down the valley, the light warm on his face. Static camera.

dialogue.line: In my father's hall we counted the year by what we buried and what we sowed. That was how we knew where we were.

scenes.visual: Close-up, reverse angle. The princess's face fills much of the frame, the valley a soft blur of green and silver behind her. She watches him carefully. Static camera.

dialogue.line: You will stop counting. Everyone does. And on the day you stop, you will be happy.

scenes.visual: Three-quarter shot from the waist up, the green valley wide behind him. He answers without smiling. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Then let me be the last man in the world who still remembers how to count. Someone should.
